connector.name: MCP by pantheon.run
connector.registryDescription: Search your Pantheon contacts, read cross-channel message timelines, and query the AI brain.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.pantheon.run over streamable HTTP. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace run.pantheon, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Optional. Omit to connect via browser sign-in — the server advertises its OAuth authorization server, so a spec-compliant client registers itself and completes the consent flow with no pasted key. Supply `Bearer pk_live_<key>` (a Pantheon developer API key with the `mcp` scope, created under Settings → Developer) only for the full tool surface, which adds `ai_query`.
